description:
Hiii,

I am Halima Riffi, an exchange student in Finland for this Fall. I am a computer science student with a specialization in AI. I am interested in this challenge because it would be a great idea to challenge my capabilities. Am I ready ?Nop, Am I supposed to be ready? Nop, but it is all about taking the risk to learn and be the best version of all times.  if you feel you are not ready or not qualified, you are  more than welcome to proof that you can do it .
summary:
The aim of this first-timer team was to create an app to evaluate the health of an astronaut. We had an ambitious plan, but faced technical difficulties in implementation and after a large effort decided to return the project unfinished. We learned a lot about teamwork, the necessity of a clear plan and team structure. 

We relied on AI tools to help us with conceptualization and design, but also tested our own skills and understanding to attempt a working prototype of the system.

We learned many lessons during this project which we will take with us and learn from. Thank you to the global and local organizers and thank you to the best first team ever :)
details:
CrewCheck app -

  1. The app fetches simulated astronaut-specific health data from a database, as well as environmental indicators that could be of interest to the astronaut​
  2. An AI tool evaluates fetched data to assess the astronaut's overall situation​
  3. All values as well as AI evaluation are shown in the app's dashboard for easy viewing and self-evaluation.​
